ns0:svg.ns0:text: Raw Pins v15 · proposed ten-core ribbon + normally-open button
Prime P11 display scale 27; Raw display scale 84 drawing units/mm. Symbolic plugs; physical fit unverified.
J37.1–10 → J1.1–10: all ten cores connected
J2.3 → SW1 A (PB1); J2.10 → SW1 B (GND)
Other GPIO: ribbon-connected; no peripheral attached
Proposal only: exact plug MPN/orientation/fit OPEN
Same copper nets; no additional external wires
Exterior enlarged; fine board continuations in details
